notes.general_comments:
Candidates scored well with Questions 1, 2, 6, 7 (ii) and (iii) and 8 (i). More challenges were found in
Questions 3, 4(i) and (ii), 7 (i) and 8 (ii). Arithmetic and algebraic errors reduced scores in many solutions,
which were initially well attempted. In questions, such as 2, 3, 5 and 6, the answers were well started but
sign and numerical errors reduced the overall marks gained. In the later questions candidates knew how to
address the problem(s) posed, but some lacked confidence in their answers. In Questions 6, 7 (ii) and (iii),
and 8(i) few problems were encountered, and generally very accurate solutions were seen.
